members.name: BuildExecutor
members.signature: public BuildExecutor(ExecutionLimits? limits = null, Action<BuildStage, int, int>? onProgress = null)

docs.summary: Initializes a new instance of BuildExecutor. Limits default to [`ExecutionLimits`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Build.ExecutionLimits) with its default values. onProgress receives the stage that just finished, how many stages are done and how many there are. Stages rather than operations, because that is the only count known before the work is planned.

members.name: RunAsync
members.signature: public async Task<BuildOutcome> RunAsync(BuildPipeline pipeline, BuildContext context, CancellationToken ct = default)

docs.summary: Walks the stage graph from the pipeline, running ready stages concurrently as their dependencies complete, and returns the build outcome. Throws `OperationCanceledException` if the cancellation token is triggered.
